title: Arm delivers record first-quarter for total revenue
summary: Arm Q1 FYE27 quarterly earnings mark record royalty and licensing revenue for a first quarter, with data center royalties doubling year over year.
body_markdown:
👏Congratulations to @liquidai on the launch of LFM3, its new family of compact, open-weight models spanning text, vision, audio and decision-making!


We're proud to support LFM3 from day one, building on our collaboration with Liquid AI to advance efficient, on-device AI

Introducing 𝙻𝙵𝙼𝟹: our new generation of Liquid Foundation Models. With a new tri-hybrid architecture and new multimodal encoders, the LFM3 family is the ideal model suite for specialized intelligence.
